# forgejo_tag_protection (Resource)

Forgejo tag protection resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    forgejo = {
      source = "svalabs/forgejo"
    }
  }
}

provider "forgejo" {
  host = "http://localhost:3000"
}

# Personal repository
resource "forgejo_repository" "test_repo" {
  name        = "personal_test_repo"
  description = "Terraform Test Repo owned by user"
  auto_init   = true
}

# Tag protection for release tags
# Note: the API requires at least one whitelisted user or team on creation
resource "forgejo_tag_protection" "releases" {
  repository_id       = forgejo_repository.test_repo.id
  name_pattern        = "v*"
  whitelist_usernames = ["tfadmin"]
}

# Example how to import existing tag protections
# id follows the format: <owner>/<repo>/<protection_id>
import {
  id = "tfadmin/personal_test_repo/1"
  to = forgejo_tag_protection.releases
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name_pattern` (String) Glob pattern of the tag names to protect, e.g. `v*`.
- `repository_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the repository. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `whitelist_teams` (Set of String) Whitelisted teams allowed to create or delete protected tags. **Note**: The Forgejo API requires at least one whitelisted user or team when creating a tag protection, and silently drops whitelisted teams without access to the repository.
- `whitelist_usernames` (Set of String) Whitelisted users allowed to create or delete protected tags. **Note**: The Forgejo API requires at least one whitelisted user or team when creating a tag protection, and silently drops whitelisted users without access to the repository.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time at which the tag protection was created.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the tag protection.
- `updated_at` (String) Time at which the tag protection was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the repo_owner/repo_name/protection_id.
terraform import forgejo_tag_protection.releases tfadmin/personal_test_repo/1
```
